root_idea.summary: Worshipful devotion and drawing near to God, expressed through devotional acts and offerings.
root_idea.development: The lexical network extends this orientation to the worshipper, prescribed ritual acts and their stations—especially in pilgrimage—and the sacrificial offering. Classical evidence also attests worship as a transitive action and deliberate devotion.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized citation form مَنْسَك, covering the supplied singular and plural Quranic forms.
Displayed under the singular active-participial citation form نَاسِك rather than the inflected plural QAC lemma.
Displayed as the distinct Quranic noun نُسُك.

senses.definition: An appointed rite or act of worship; collectively, the rites and ceremonies of pilgrimage.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for prescribed religious observances, whether a single rite or the collective rites of a community or pilgrimage.

senses.definition: An appointed station or setting in which a rite of worship is performed.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran-focused lexical description encompasses both the stations or settings of worship and the acts performed there; the supplied contextual renderings emphasize the acts and rites.

senses.definition: A worshipper or devotee, especially one engaged in prescribed devotional or pilgrimage rites.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrence is the plural active participle نَاسِكُوهُ, denoting those who perform the appointed rite referred to by the attached pronoun.

senses.definition: Worship or a devotional observance offered to God.
senses.usage_conditions: A broad religious use referring to an act or practice of worship.

senses.definition: A sacrificial offering or sacrificial rite performed as an act of devotion.
senses.usage_conditions: In sacrificial contexts, the noun denotes the offering or rite of slaughter; it may also frame sacrificial observance as part of one's worship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To worship; to practice worship in a transitive construction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form I verbal use explicitly described as transitive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wash and purify a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This usage is reported with an evidential qualification in the supplied lexical source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To devote oneself to religious exercises, apply oneself to devotion, or become a worshipper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form V devotional use, including the resulting state of becoming a نَاسِك.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sacrificial animal or offering slaughtered as a devotional act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is specialized to the slaughtered sacrificial victim in the supplied lexical discussion.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Devotional dedication and becoming a worshipper.
Pointer-only cross-reference; no lexical definition is supplied in the unit.
Ritual-rite and ritual-place branches are covered under مَنْسَك.

cautions: The QAC grouping places the singular مَنْسَك and plural مَنَاسِك forms under one public noun entry.

The station or place component is supported by the Quran-focused lexical description together with the Classical definition, while the supplied contextual glosses primarily render the Quranic occurrences as rites.
The root source reports, with reservation, an alternative claim that مَنْسَك can mean a place one frequents; that disputed claim is not adopted as an established meaning.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Maqayis reports a disputed alternative meaning for مَنْسَك, namely a place one frequents, but immediately expresses reservations about it; it is therefore preserved as unresolved rather than presented as an established sense.
